name: Monthly newsletter #1 — Discovering Garabandal (July 2026, EN)
subject: {{first_name}}, 3 readings to discover Garabandal from the beginning
intro: This is the first edition of our monthly newsletter. Every month we will choose a few readings from our website — articles, testimonies and the life of the mission — for you to read calmly, pray with, and share with those you love.
For this first edition, we wanted to start at the beginning: the history, the witnesses and the life of the Apostolate.

articles.title: The History of Garabandal
articles.excerpt: The history of the apparitions of Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Garabandal, told from the beginning: the four girls, the messages, and what happened in that mountain village.

articles.title: Meeting with Jacinta González
articles.excerpt: A meeting with Jacinta González, one of the visionaries of Garabandal, during a presentation on the apparitions in Louisiana, USA.

articles.title: Our first E-Pilgrimage at Garabandal!
articles.excerpt: How the Apostolate brought Garabandal to pilgrims around the world — praying together, directly from the village.
